text: Foundation epic complete in commit 8641770. All seven child gates are closed and the epic is live-ready. A shared dynamic-to-typed analytical workflow passes on JVM and Scala.js; core, storage, relational semantics, normalization, resource ownership, CSV/Arrow IO, and extraction laws are green. The external-package consumer compile suite and zero internal module dependencies establish the ntab consumption direction without coupling Frame back to neuroimaging code. Standalone mechanical renaming to frame4s passes 41 core tests on each platform plus FS2 9 JVM and 8 JS. Typelevel remains an affiliate-first candidate rather than a claimed home or coordinate.
